decisionProcess.summary: CFE has a formal electronic contracting and supplier-procedure route. Public evidence supports centralized procurement governance but not the operational route for hotel rooms or meetings. Use official channels to request referral to administration/procurement, HR/training and Peninsular/Cancún operations.
decisionProcess.notes: The 2025 programme supports structured procurement and travel/training categories, but no hotel-specific tender, TMC or preferred-supplier evidence was found.
unknowns: Hotel address, website, brand and exact location are unresolved.
No named CFE hotel buyer, travel manager, meetings procurement owner or TMC relationship was verified.
Yesica Luna Espino and Cecilia Braña Vázquez are relevant administration/HR contacts, but personal authority to contract hotels was not established.
Preferred hotels, booking channel, local-office discretion and transient/meetings sourcing split are unknown.
Current status of the Cancún/Riviera Maya project and any remaining 2026 travel requirement must be confirmed.
No room-night volume, event dates, budget or procurement threshold was found.
Contractor/supplier travel must not be attributed to CFE without confirmation.
